name: Matsukaze Azuki
source:
Self-proclaimed scrap hunter, and avid collector of retro vehicles of all kinds and sizes.

This enterprising woman makes a living traveling through the country and buying scrapped cars and vehicles for a pittance, repairing them and selling them off in the next town.

She has the curious habit of giving nicknames to the people she meets.

Her chosen nickname for Sumomo is "Bitchy Peaches," and Kanna earned the moniker of "Candy Boy."

[From [url=https://laplacian.jp/yonagi/en]Laplacian[/url]]
